decoder: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
method: Read every decoded original MOV presentation timestamp with ffprobe frame pts_time and independently decode the complete video with ffmpeg into a discarded null sink. Only the discarded sink uses setpts=N to avoid muxer DTS rounding warnings; original MOV bytes and indexed raw PTS are untouched. Non-monotonic raw timestamps are recorded rather than sorted away. No requested seek time, nominal FPS, generated frames, PNG editing or source changes.
scope: Derived local read-only verification of the actual downloaded native recording. Original native probe/export failure remains recorded. Whole-movie gaps include static setup and shutdown; this is recorded-frame coverage, not gameplay or physical display FPS, joint approval or audible playback.
